coordinate_system.orientation_notes: The primary part axis is taken as X based on the section A-A axis_direction values and the concentric cylindrical features in the left view. Radial directions are perpendicular to X. Detail X is treated as a local enlarged axial/radial view despite its coordinate note using Z for the local horizontal axis.

features.name: End taper 40°
features.description: Angled face forming a taper or chamfer at the end of the component.

features.name: Outer blend radius R6.50
features.description: Convex radius blending the angled end face to the outer diameter surface.

features.name: Inner blend fillet R2.00
features.description: Concave fillet blending the angled end face to the internal bore surface.

features.name: Central bore
features.description: Inner central bore with a limit tolerance and a minimum length specified.

features.name: Outer cylinder
features.description: Main outer cylindrical body with a limit tolerance.

features.name: Overall Part
features.description: The overall body of the tubular part, showing total length.

features.name: Central Outer Straight Section
features.description: The main outer cylindrical surface with a specified surface finish.

features.name: Central Internal Cavity
features.description: The maximum diameter straight bore section at the center of the part's internal profile.

relationships.detail: The end view shows the central bore and outer cylinder as concentric cylindrical features sharing the same axis direction.
The section view describes both the central internal cavity and central outer straight section on the same part axis.
Both internal cylindrical zones are described as central bores/cavities along the primary part axis, but they are not grouped because their diameters describe different axial zones.
Both external cylindrical zones are along the primary part axis, but they are not grouped because their diameters describe different axial zones.
The outer blend radius is described as blending into the angled 40 degree end taper.
Detail X is called out at the transition from the central straight outer cylinder; the R6.50 outer blend ties the detail profile to that outer diameter surface.
The inner blend fillet is described as blending into the angled 40 degree end taper.
The inner blend fillet is described as blending to the internal bore surface at the end profile.

datum_scheme.datum_hierarchy_notes: No datum definitions or GD&T datum references were extracted. The A labels present in the drawing data are treated as section-cut designators, not datum feature symbols.

feature_graph.part_notes: Material: SAE J403 GRADE 1010-1020 CD STEEL. Material standard: SAE J403. Scale: 1:1. General tolerance: ASME Y14.5M-1994. Projection: third angle. Heat treatment: none specified. Coating: CORROSION RESISTANT COAT PER SEE TAB. General notes: FINISH: CORROSION RESISTANT COAT PER SEE TAB. DEBURR: BREAK ALL SHARP EDGES 0.5 MAX.. Testing: CRUSH TEST per PS-122.5 (220kN, 110kN, 0.54mm).

assumptions.text: No identity groups were created between left_view:F1 and section_a_a:F3 because their diameters describe different internal axial zones, even though section cut A-A passes through the central bore.

No identity group was created between left_view:F2 and section_a_a:F2 because their diameters describe different external axial zones, even though both are coaxial and section cut A-A passes through the part center.

The X detail callout attached near section_a_a:F2 was interpreted as locating the adjacent end-transition detail, not as making the Detail X radius/chamfer features duplicates of the central straight outer cylinder.
Unattached callout UC1 was dropped because it is explicitly marked REF and appears to be a reference end-length value rather than a controlling feature dimension.
The primary coordinate axis was chosen as X from the main section and feature axis_direction data; the Detail X note using Z for its local horizontal axis was treated as a local-view convention only.
The 7.05 mm [.278 in] callout defines the axial length or step depth of the shoulder feature.
The Ø28.94 MAX central internal cavity extends axially across the central enlarged bore section, bounded on both ends by internal tapered transition steps.

The internal transition profile between the central cavity (Ø28.94 MAX) and the end bores is defined as a smooth, curved contour extending symmetrically from the inner end of the 14mm minimum straight end bore to the central diameter.
